dataset: 300 mixtures (3 noise categories x 5 SNR levels x 20 speakers), 48 kHz, synthetic
note_dataset_correction: This is a REGENERATED evaluation (2026-08-24), superseding the 2026-08-23 version. The prior run's impulsive category noise pool was silently missing the gunshot (2148 files) and artillery (30 files) corpora -- data/noise/impulsive/ contained only the 40-file explosion (ESC-50 fireworks proxy) subtype, due to an incomplete Zenodo download that a manifest-regeneration commit (feb019c) papered over instead of surfacing. All 100 'impulsive' mixtures in that run were actually explosion-only, despite being labeled/reported as 'Gunshot/Artillery'. The gunshot/artillery corpus (Zenodo Record 7004819, CC BY 4.0) has been re-fetched and the full pipeline (manifest -> mixtures -> baselines -> DeepFilterNet -> evaluation) regenerated end to end. Stationary and non_stationary categories were never affected by this gap (their noise corpora were always complete) and their numbers are unchanged from the prior run.
note_artillery_reconstruction: The original script that produced the documented 30-file 'artillery' proxy subset was not preserved in the repository, so it could not be bit-for-bit reproduced. The corpus (2148 files across 4 firearm types: glock_17_9mm_caliber, ruger_ar_556_dot223_caliber, 38s&ws_dot38_caliber, remington_870_12_gauge) was re-split using the same documented rationale (data/SOURCES.md: 'large-caliber firearm shots selected to simulate artillery') -- all 2148 files across all 4 types used as 'gunshot' (matches the documented count exactly), and the first 30 files (sorted, deterministic) from remington_870_12_gauge (12-gauge shotgun, the highest-energy/largest-caliber type of the four) used as the 'artillery' proxy subset.
note_snr_substitution: PS26052 states 'SNR > 15 dB' as a target. The evaluation uses SI-SNR (Scale-Invariant Signal-to-Noise Ratio) as the practical measurable substitute, because SI-SNR is computed against the paired clean reference (clean_ref_path) from the mixed corpus and is scale-invariant, making it a more rigorous and reproducible substitute than raw segSNR for this synthetic-dataset evaluation. This substitution is stated explicitly and does not apply to any claim about raw SNR on real hardware.
note_pesq_snr_conditional: PESQ-WB is SNR-input-dependent: at higher input SNR the model has less noise to suppress and its outputs score higher. Per-SNR conditional breakdowns are shown in the supplementary section below for context, but the compliance verdict uses the full category mean across all 5 input SNR levels (-5 to +15 dB), which is the correct aggregate for a dataset evaluation.

stationary.PESQ_WB_note: 2.4823 < 2.5 target. Miss margin: 0.018. Unchanged from prior run (stationary noise pool was never affected).

non_stationary.SI_SNR_note: 10.75 dB < 15 dB target. Driven almost entirely by the crowd/babble subtype -- see docs/non_stationary_root_cause.md for the subtype-level decomposition (helicopter alone: STOI 0.91, +8.9 dB dSI-SNR, on par with the strongest categories).
non_stationary.STOI_note: 0.8297 < 0.85 target. Miss margin: 0.020. Unchanged from prior run (non-stationary noise pool was never affected).
non_stationary.PESQ_WB_note: 2.1303 < 2.5 target. Miss margin: 0.370. Largest gap across all categories.

impulsive.PESQ_WB_note: 2.5841 > 2.5 target. Headroom: +0.084. PASSES with the corrected dataset (real gunshot/artillery corpus) -- the prior run's 2.4916 FAIL was measured on explosion-only noise, not the documented gunshot/artillery mix.

overall_summary.SI_SNR: 2 of 3 categories PASS (stationary, impulsive). Non-stationary FAILS at 10.75 dB.
overall_summary.STOI: 2 of 3 categories PASS (stationary, impulsive). Non-stationary FAILS at 0.83.
overall_summary.PESQ_WB: 1 of 3 categories PASS (impulsive, 2.58). Stationary narrowly misses (2.48, -0.018). Non-stationary substantially misses (2.13, -0.370).
overall_summary.verdict: DeepFilterNet3 meets all three DRDO targets (SI-SNR, STOI, PESQ-WB) on impulsive noise with the corrected gunshot/artillery dataset, and meets SI-SNR/STOI (not PESQ-WB) on stationary noise. Non-stationary noise remains the significant gap across all three metrics, driven specifically by the crowd/babble subtype (see docs/non_stationary_root_cause.md), not helicopter.
